title: Evidence index
description: Every evidence identifier the site may cite, mapped to a stub. Generated by scripts/build_data.py from the campaign store. An identifier printed as a receipt anywhere on the site must resolve here or the build fails: components/provenance-chip.md acceptance criterion 2, enforced in src/components/base/data.ts resolveEvidence(). Identifiers outside this set are payload captures and are labelled store-only where they appear.
